description: The figure presents a circular diagram illustrating the components and their associated values in a framework for language models following multiple turns of entangled instructions. The diagram is divided into several colored segments, each representing a different component with a corresponding numerical value. The components include "Prioritization" (100), "Personalization" (100), "Privacy Protection" (111), "Multitasking" (160), "Triggers" (100), "Recursive Reasoning" (110), "Dynamic Environment" (100), "Memorization" (100), and "Dynamic Instruction" (100). The central part of the diagram highlights two key processes: "Contradiction Resolution" and "Context Tracking," which are further supported by "Context Retrieving." The segments are arranged in a circular pattern around the central processes, with each segment's color and label clearly indicated by lines connecting to the outer edge of the diagram. The values associated with each component are displayed next to their respective labels, providing a quantitative measure of each component's significance within the framework. The overall layout emphasizes the interconnectedness of these components and their roles in enabling language models to effectively follow complex, multi-turn instructions.
